name: Reply
description_en:
Reply’s official how.reply.io documentation describes a sales engagement platform with email, LinkedIn, call, SMS, task and Zapier steps, a prospect database, consolidated inbox, CRM integrations and Jason AI. WhatsApp appears as a sequence task; the capability answers explicitly say automatic WhatsApp sending is unavailable. Distinguish supported step types from fully automated channel execution. Jason is a specific AI SDR product within Reply, not a synonym for every account’s entitlement.

A sequence holds ordered steps, delays, conditions and variants. The design documentation states that one delay day equals twenty-four hours and weekends count. Conditions split into Yes/No branches for a monitored period; maximum new daily contacts controls enrollment, separate from follow-up sending. A small pilot should verify sender schedule, field substitutions and stop behavior for a reply, bounce, unsubscribe and booking. Do not copy general outreach benchmarks as a promise of results.
description_zh:
Reply 的官方 how.reply.io 文档描述销售跟进平台，包含邮件、LinkedIn、电话、短信、任务与 Zapier 步骤，以及线索数据库、集中收件箱、CRM 集成和 Jason AI。WhatsApp 可作为序列任务出现，但能力说明明确表示不支持自动发送 WhatsApp。应区分支持的步骤类型与全自动渠道执行。Jason 是 Reply 内的具体 AI SDR 产品，不代表每个账户都具有该权益。

序列包含有序步骤、延迟、条件与变体。设计文档说明延迟一天等于二十四小时，周末也计算。条件在监测期间分为 Yes／No 分支；每日新联系人上限控制入序，与后续发送不同。小型试点应验证发送时间、字段替换，以及回复、退信、退订和预约的停止行为。不能把通用触达基准复制为效果承诺。

Evaluation scope.en: Official public documentation research. Account setup, integrations and delivery were not executed.
Evaluation scope.zh: 研究官方公开资料；未实际注册、运行集成或验证交付。

steps.en: A sequence holds ordered steps, delays, conditions and variants. The design documentation states that one delay day equals twenty-four hours and weekends count. Conditions split into Yes/No branches for a monitored period; maximum new daily contacts controls enrollment, separate from follow-up sending. A small pilot should verify sender schedule, field substitutions and stop behavior for a reply, bounce, unsubscribe and booking. Do not copy general outreach benchmarks as a promise of results.
steps.zh: 序列包含有序步骤、延迟、条件与变体。设计文档说明延迟一天等于二十四小时，周末也计算。条件在监测期间分为 Yes／No 分支；每日新联系人上限控制入序，与后续发送不同。小型试点应验证发送时间、字段替换，以及回复、退信、退订和预约的停止行为。不能把通用触达基准复制为效果承诺。

items.en: The troubleshooting page explicitly says there is no duplicate guard on enrichment submissions: submitting the same contacts again charges again. Large batches can also return too late to save results; the page recommends smaller batches and contacting support with submitted and returned counts when they do not reconcile. Reply fits teams coordinating prospecting and follow-up with an owner for exceptions. It is a managed account service; source licensing and self-hosting were not established, and no integration was executed.
items.zh: 排错页明确说明数据补充提交没有重复保护：再次提交同一批联系人会再次收费。大批次也可能因返回太晚而未保存结果；页面建议缩小批次，对不上时带提交与返回数量联系支持。Reply 适合有异常负责人、需要协调找客户与跟进的团队。它是托管账户服务，未确认源代码许可和自托管，本次没有运行集成。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: The pricing page returned 403, so current subscription amounts, free-plan availability and trial terms remain unverified. Official troubleshooting documents a separate data-credit mechanism: LinkedIn-profile enrichment costs one credit per attempted contact even when no data is found; email finding costs two and phone finding three, refunded on a miss. Email validation costs one, and an undeliverable verdict is still a result. These documented operation rates do not establish which subscription includes the required credits.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 定价页返回 403，因此当前订阅金额、免费套餐与试用条件仍未核实。官方排错文档记录独立的数据额度机制：LinkedIn 档案补充每条尝试收一额度，即使无结果；找邮箱两额度、找电话三额度，未找到会退还。验证邮箱一额度，“不可送达”的判断仍算结果。这些操作费率不能证明某订阅包含所需额度。
